encodingDesc.p: The page image is authoritative. Hathi OCR and the 2014 XML are comparison witnesses only. Printed text is not silently corrected. Verse lines use numbered l elements. Citation hierarchy is author.work.fragment.line.

cRefPattern.p: This pointer pattern extracts lines within fragments.

revisionDesc.change: Split the volume-level OCR draft into canonical TLG author and work files. Running-head continuations were folded into their works; wording was not corrected. The page image remains authoritative and the transcription requires human review.

lg.l: ὡς ὑπό τι νυστάζειν γε καὐτὸς ἄρχομαι.
ἡ τἀγαθοῦ γὰρ δαίμονος συνέσεισέ με
ἡ τοῦ δὲ σωτῆρος Διὸς τάχιστά γε
ἀπώλεσε ναύτην καὶ κατεπόντωσέν μ᾽ ὁρᾶς.

div.note: Athenaeus 15, 693 b Ξέναρχος ἐν Διδύμοις κτλ.

1. ὑπό τι Pors.] εύποτι A. cf. quae idem adnotavit ad Arist. Vesp. 281. 2. ητ᾿ αγαθοῦ Α. γὰρ add. Mein. in Ath. συνέσισέ Α. 3. ἄκρατος ex A add. Cobet. Or. 105. cf. Schoell. Herm. IIII 163. 5. ἀπώλεσε ναύτην Canter.] ἀπώλεσεν αὐτὴν Α. scr. ἀπώλεσ᾽ ἀνέδην, quod adverbium frequens est apud Platonem philosophum. nam natantem quidem potor se dicere potest, nautam vix potest. κατεπόντωσέν Schweigh.] κατεπόντωσέ Α. — de ioci genere Arist. Plut. 1174. 5 contulit Dobraeus. ὁρᾶς. cf. quae adnotavimus ad Arist. Nub. 355. inter duos fratres distribuit Naber. Mnem. nov. VIII 267.

lg.l: πίμπλη σὺ μὲν ἐμοί, σοὶ δ᾽ ἐγὼ δώσω πιεῖν·

div.note: Athenaeus 10, 426 b ταῦτα ἔφη Ξέναρχος (ξενόχαρτος Α) ἐν Διδύμοις.

1. πίμπλη Mein.] πίμπλα Α. Πάμφιλε Herwerd. Anal. crit. 43. recte Kusterum Xenarchi nomen restituisse testatur Suidas Ξέναρχος. alterum versum proverbialiter dictum esse monuit Schweigh.: quamquam nihil eiusmodi apud paroemiographos.
